label: Warehouse HRI thresholds, declared 2026-10-19 from the project spec and nominal robot data before any trial; not tuned on results. Set frozen to true after the development trials, before the final trials. Any later change must be disclosed in the README.
output_root_note: Relative to the Unity project folder (the folder that contains Assets/) in the Editor; to the player's data folder in a build. outputs/ is git-ignored.

trials.task_note: Task1 = straight A to B with FORWARD at the first junction (baseline); Task2 = guided route, B changes every trial; GestureSweep = development gesture evaluation (see gesture_sweep).
trials.mode_note: development uses dev_seed; final uses final_seed, needs frozen = true, and runs once (refused if a trials_final_* folder with FINAL_DONE.json exists).

robot.dimensions_note: Nominal MiR100 datasheet footprint 0.89 x 0.58 x 0.35 m (L x W x H), not measured in the scene; the body is a box stand-in until the URDF model is imported.

brain.safety_note: Person-in-path stop: ahead of the robot centre within 1.2 m and within 0.6 m of its centre line. 1.2 m = half length 0.445 + emergency stopping distance at 1.0 m/s (1.0^2 / (2 x 1.5) = 0.33) + 0.1 s reaction (0.1) + 0.3 margin. Must stay below approach_distance_m so the worker being asked never triggers it.

link.link_note: enabled: Unity connects to the Python bridge (robot_vision/hri_bridge_server.py) and sends observations; replies are logged but decisions stay on the scripted baselines (shadow mode) until Step 4. link_required: the robot stops by itself when Python has been silent for watchdog_s, and trials wait for the link before starting.
link.cam360_note: Changed 2026-10-20 after the first development trials (hri_dev_eval_20261020_025237: people recall 0.09 at 3-6 m): was the full panorama at 1024 px and JPEG 75. Now the horizon band +30..-60 deg at the native 2048 px width, JPEG 90. See robot_vision/configs/hri_perception.json -> changes_after_dev_eval.

perception.mode_note: scripted = scripted-perception and scripted-gesture baselines (true positions, scripted poses); vision = people and gestures from the Python bridge (robot_vision/hri_bridge_server.py with perception 'vision'); vision makes the Python link required (watchdog, trials wait for Python). Every run log names the sources.
perception.unknown_distance_note: A person vision sees but cannot range (no ground contact) is placed this close: conservative, it can trigger the person-in-path stop; it is never used for scoring.

gesture_sweep.note: Development gesture evaluation (trials.task = 'GestureSweep', development mode only): the robot stands still, the worker shows each of the seven commands (incl. NONE) 'repeats' times in a seeded random order, at a random distance, view angle and worker yaw; truth goes to truth_sweep.csv, read only by robot_vision/hri_eval_dev.py.
